content:
Hi everyone, first time posting here. 

I've been working on formalizing distributed systems in Lean 4 library (things like crash-ecovery message passing, quorum intersection, CAP, a choice-free FLP proof, vector clocks, and a fenced quorum lease protocol): https://github.com/substratum-labs/harmonia

Right now I kept the library Init-only (using List.Nodup for finite sets) so that downstream systems projects can compile it quickly without pulling in Mathlib.

I noticed that cslib recently added a formalization of FLP using Mathlib's Fintype and Classical.choose. For those working on CS / distributed algorithms in Lean: is it better to keep an Init-only core and maintain a separate thin bridge to Mathlib (Finset, PartialOrder), or would some of these models (like quorum intersection, vector clocks, or CAP) be useful to adapt directly into cslib?
Thanks.
